pages.text: Now, by following a certain diet, you can either become stronger or die altogether. When you go into the inventory, you will notice an icon with food.

pages.title: The Diet icon
pages.text: Clicking on it will open the diet interface.

pages.title: Interface
pages.text: Every food here has its own characteristics.
By eating a variety of things, you upgrade certain groups. If there is the same thing, then firstly, the food will give less satiety, and secondly, other indicators will decrease.
After almost completely pumping the group, you will get certain effects that can be viewed above the diet indicators.
